stories.title: El Gobierno se niega a retirar los decretos de vivienda: «Ha llegado la hora de que PP, Vox y Junts se retraten»

en.title: Government refuses to withdraw housing decrees: "It is time for PP, Vox and Junts to show their position"
en.summary: The Spanish Government will not withdraw two housing-related decrees scheduled for a parliamentary vote on Friday, despite Junts' opposition. Officials state the decrees were developed over months to build consensus on housing needs.

stories.title: Ayuso reacciona en directo al doble portazo de Junts a los decretos de vivienda: "Sánchez va a llevar a España a la revolución. Prepara el terreno para elecciones"

en.title: Ayuso reacts on air to Junts' double rejection of housing decrees: "Sánchez will lead Spain to revolution. He is preparing the ground for elections"
en.summary: Madrid's regional president Ayuso criticized the Government's housing decrees amid Junts' rejection, alleging the executive is deliberately creating tension and laying groundwork for early elections.

stories.title: Cargas de los Mossos para evitar el asedio a la Jefatura de Policía de Layetana en el noveno aniversario del 1-O

en.title: Mossos charges to prevent siege of Layetana Police Headquarters on ninth anniversary of 1-O
en.summary: Police deployed crowd control measures during a demonstration commemorating the ninth anniversary of Catalonia's independence referendum after radical groups threw fireworks and objects at officers guarding a police building.

stories.title: Junts tumbará los dos decretos de vivienda y priva al Gobierno de una victoria que le dé oxígeno

en.title: Junts will block two housing decrees and deny Government a victory to provide momentum
en.summary: Junts will reject the Government's two housing decrees and demands the executive withdraw and renegotiate the legislation, arguing the current text will produce opposite effects on the rental market.

stories.title: Contenedores quemados y altercados frente a la Jefatura Superior de Policía de Via Laietana y en Urquinaona por el noveno aniversario del 1-O

en.title: Burned containers and clashes outside the Superior Police Headquarters on Via Laietana and in Urquinaona for the ninth anniversary of 1-O
en.summary: Protesters gathered near police headquarters on the ninth anniversary of Catalonia's independence referendum, throwing firecrackers, eggs, and smoke canisters at police officers.

stories.title: En estado crítico la presa que sobrevivió a la inyección letal en Tennessee

en.title: Woman who survived lethal injection in Tennessee in critical condition
en.summary: Christa Pike, 50, survived two doses of lethal injection during an execution attempt in Tennessee and was hospitalized. Her case raises questions about what happens to death row inmates who survive execution.

stories.title: Christa Pike, "en estado crítico" un día después del fallido intento de Tennessee de ejecutarla

en.title: Christa Pike "in critical condition" one day after Tennessee's failed execution attempt
en.summary: The attorney for the death row inmate who survived execution in Tennessee characterized the failed procedure as torture and stated she is receiving medical care to save her life.

stories.title: Tennessee governor halts executions after Christa Pike survives two lethal injections

en.title: Tennessee governor halts executions after Christa Pike survives two lethal injections
en.summary: The Tennessee governor suspended executions following an unprecedented situation where an inmate survived two lethal injections and required hospitalization for emergency medical care.

stories.title: El Madrid cae ante el Hapoel y firma el peor inicio de su historia en Euroliga

en.title: Real Madrid loses to Hapoel and signs worst start in its Euroleague history
en.summary: Real Madrid suffered its third defeat in three games, marking the worst start in club Euroleague history. Despite nearly overcoming a 20-point deficit, Madrid could not maintain momentum in the final quarter against Hapoel.

stories.title: Un británico-iraní detenido en Londres por su supuesta relación con el incidente de la base estadounidense Fairford

en.title: British-Iranian detained in London for alleged involvement in Fairford US base incident
en.summary: A British-Iranian individual was arrested in London in connection with an incident at the American Fairford air base. Reports suggest those involved may have been attempting to steal fuel.

stories.title: La asombrosa remontada del Real Madrid al Hapoel no evita el peor arranque europeo de toda su historia

en.title: Real Madrid's remarkable comeback against Hapoel fails to prevent worst European start in history
en.summary: Real Madrid lost its third consecutive away game in Europe's top competition despite mounting an impressive 22-point comeback. Bryant's late performance secured victory for Hapoel.

stories.title: El "peligro extraordinario" de lluvias en Valencia y Castellón suspende las clases y la circulación de los trenes de cercanías y la conexión con Cataluña

en.title: "Extraordinary danger" from rainfall in Valencia and Castellón suspends classes and regional train circulation and connection with Catalonia
en.summary: Regional authorities in Spain upgraded weather alerts to red level for Valencia and Castellón, leading to suspension of train services and school closures in around thirty municipalities.

stories.title: El Gobierno reta a "retratarse" a Junts y se niega a retirar los decretos

en.title: Government challenges Junts to "expose itself" and refuses to withdraw decrees
en.summary: The Spanish government rejected Junts' proposal to withdraw two housing decrees and will maintain them despite the party's announcement of opposition. The decrees are expected to be rejected in tomorrow's congressional vote.

stories.title: Auren y Kepler califican de "inviable" el plande salvamento de Urbas

en.title: Auren and Kepler describe Urbas rescue plan as "unviable"
en.summary: Two firms have assessed that a proposed rescue plan for Urbas is not viable.

stories.title: Junts tumbará los dos decretos de vivienda del Gobierno

en.title: Junts will block the Government's two housing decrees
en.summary: The independentist party demands an immediate Cabinet meeting to modify the first text and bring it to Congress for approval the following week.

stories.title: Trump valora que EEUU compre acciones de OpenAI y Anthropic

en.title: Trump considers the United States buying stakes in OpenAI and Anthropic
en.summary: The U.S. President indicated openness to the possibility of government investment in AI companies, noting the U.S. is already a shareholder in Intel.

stories.title: La plantilla de Airbus acepta por mayoría la última propuesta para poner fin al conflicto en España

en.title: Airbus workforce accepts majority proposal to end conflict in Spain
en.summary: Airbus employees have voted in favor of the latest proposal designed to resolve the labor dispute affecting the company's Spanish operations.
